strings.zh: 我不得不承认{NEWLINE}你的进攻非常犀利！{CLEAR}想和大叔我再对战吗？{SCROLL}那就把电话号码告诉我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Sheesh, the way you attacked! That was{NEWLINE}something else! We should meet again!{SCROLL}How about giving me your number?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我想和你对战的时候{NEWLINE}会打电话给你的！
strings.en: I’ll call you when I feel like battling!

strings.zh: 虽然被你拒绝了,{NEWLINE}但我不沮丧！{SCROLL}等你想和大叔对战了{NEWLINE}就再来我这边吧！
strings.en: No? That’s fine.{NEWLINE}A definite no is easy to take!{SCROLL}I’ll be right here when you’re ready for{NEWLINE}a rematch.

strings.zh: 啊！你来是想登录{NEWLINE}大叔的电话号码吗？{CLEAR}还想来对战吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: So you want to register my phone{NEWLINE}number for a rematch, huh?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你真的很强啊！{SCROLL}如果大树能在更年轻的时候{NEWLINE}开始精灵生涯的话⋯⋯{SCROLL}你一定要连大叔那份{NEWLINE}一同努力啊,{CLEAR}这个就送给你了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Well, you are special, all right.{SCROLL}If only I’d begun training Pokémon when{NEWLINE}I was a tad younger...{SCROLL}I want you to work hard and succeed{NEWLINE}for both of us.{CLEAR}So, take this, OK?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}大叔这能听到小河的声音！{CLEAR}难道你就在附近？
strings.en: Uh-huh?{NEWLINE}Is that a river I hear in the{CLEAR}background? You’re nearby!

strings.zh: 大叔的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}在这一带已经无敌了！{SCROLL}对了！{NEWLINE}前几天大叔还打败了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}不过,实际上我是想抓它的⋯⋯{SCROLL}下次电话再聊吧！
strings.en: Nothing can match my {VAR:0100:10} now.{SCROLL}Yeah, we KO’d a wild {VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}That was OK, but what I wanted was{NEWLINE}to catch it...{SCROLL}OK, give me a call again!

strings.zh: 大叔的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}在这一带已经无敌了！{SCROLL}昨天大叔在为那只{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}是该抓还是该打{CLEAR}而犹豫不决的时候⋯⋯{SCROLL}居然被一个路过的家伙给抓去了！{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: Nothing can match my {VAR:0100:10} now.{SCROLL}And, yesterday, we spotted a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}.{SCROLL}We were debating whether to catch{NEWLINE}it or just gain experience battling it.{SCROLL}Then, along came another guy,{NEWLINE}who caught it! How about that!{SCROLL}OK, give me a call again!

strings.zh: 你现在是不是也想{NEWLINE}和大叔再来一场对战了？{CLEAR}肯定想吧？{SCROLL}那我们在{VAR:0104:3}见面吧！
strings.en: You’re thinking you’d like to battle me.{NEWLINE}Am I right or what?{SCROLL}Yep! We’ll meet on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你还没到{VAR:0104:3}吗？{SCROLL}虽然等待也是一种享受,{NEWLINE}但大叔还是想尽快开始对战！
strings.en: Haven’t you gone as far as{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}?{SCROLL}Waiting here is no problem,{NEWLINE}but I’d sure like to battle!

strings.zh: 以后要常来和大叔对战哦！
strings.en: You’ll battle with me again, right?
